notes:
Zaiqa Billing, Zaiqa Waiter and Zaiqa Kitchen apps, version 2.14.0.

Waiters over the internet (cloud relay) - no IP address needed
- New: Cloud > "Waiters over the internet". Turn it on and copy the shop code. In the Waiter app paste the code instead of an IP address and sign in from anywhere (mobile data or any Wi-Fi).
- Wi-Fi still works as before. If the waiter app has an address it tries Wi-Fi first and switches to the cloud if Wi-Fi fails.
- Simultaneous orders, KOTs and bills from several waiters are queued and handled one by one; a repeated tap or resent request is never done twice.
- Needs the updated Cloudflare worker (run npx wrangler deploy once in the new zaiqa-worker folder).
